bounded_host_request.command:
cd /home/admin1/server-core || exit 12
printf 'HOST=%s\n' "$(hostname)"
printf 'CURRENT_USER=%s\n' "$(id -un)"
printf 'ADMIN1_GROUPS='; id -nG admin1 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'ADMIN2_ACCOUNT='; getent passwd admin2 || echo NOT_FOUND
printf 'ADMIN2_GROUPS='; id -nG admin2 2>/dev/null || echo NOT_FOUND
for p in /home/admin2 /home/admin2/.ssh /home/admin2/.ssh/authorized_keys; do if test -e "$p"; then stat -c 'PATH=%n OWNER=%U:%G PERM=%a TYPE=%F' "$p"; else printf 'PATH_MISSING=%s\n' "$p"; fi; done
if test -r /home/admin2/.ssh/authorized_keys; then printf 'AUTHORIZED_KEYS_COUNT='; grep -Ec '^(ssh-|ecdsa-|sk-)' /home/admin2/.ssh/authorized_keys || true; ssh-keygen -lf /home/admin2/.ssh/authorized_keys 2>/dev/null || true; fi
for d in /home/admin2/.ssh /home/admin1/.ssh; do if test -d "$d"; then find "$d" -maxdepth 1 -type f \( -name 'id_*' -o -name '*.pem' -o -name '*.ppk' \) -printf 'KEY_CANDIDATE=%p OWNER=%u MODE=%m\n' 2>/dev/null; fi; done
printf 'SSHD_BINARY='; command -v sshd || true
